## Checks

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass

- [ ] Keyboard, contrast and the list view still work
- [ ] Docs and `CREDITS.md` updated; no secrets; no new dependency without a reason
- [ ] Commits are `TYPE: summary`, one logical change each
